images.caption: Figure 1:HexaShell turns robot failures into reusable tools.A coding agent operates a robot with two arms through a thin harness and sees RGB images only. After a failure, an optimizer agent diagnoses the episode and writes or fixes tools that use only what the robot observes. Both agents are Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. Bottom: where tools help (rigid, planar, tool use, clutter) and where they fall short (cloth).
